rows.description: Symbolica is a high-performance computer algebra library for Python and Rust. Manipulate large expressions, match patterns, and generate optimized numerical code — at unprecedented speed.
Algorithms and data structures implemented in PHP: sorting, searching, graphs, recursion and dynamic programming, with Chinese and English learning notes. PHP 算法与数据结构学习合集。
